in_hebrew.name: לינדל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word לינד (Lind) meaning 'light, illumination, sun'. This name may have been derived from the given name Linden, which is derived from the Old English word lind 'flexible' or 'limber', which is related to the Old English word linden 'lime tree'. The meaning of the name Linden is 'flexible, limber' and is derived from the Old English word lind. The Hebrew name Lyndell is derived from Lind and means 'shining light', 'illumination', or 'sun'.
